title: Start from Flex's prototype, not only its design

options.label: Flex's prototype: its contract, CLI shape and page, generalised
options.act: Port flex-review-prototype (contract, CLI verbs, review/index.html) into Switchboard Review; one handoff for overview + Review window + menu bar + widget
options.then: Port Flex's prototype into Switchboard Review, designing what's new in the same language.

options.label: The design only, rebuilt from scratch
A fresh handoff to Claude Design

why: Claude Design drew it, and Flex has already built it. The prototype covers review mode, the journey rail, Handled with Undo, the send drawer with what each answer commits the agent to, live arrival, activity, every key, and both themes, all driven by the same data contract and a CLI the agent writes with. Generalise it (phases for stages, software media, the overview and the Record) instead of starting again. The second look adds the film-so-far view, Going ahead unless you object, two-pane activity, two kinds of notification and an agent simulator, all on the same contract.
What's new (the overview, the Boards window, the menu-bar popover, the widget) is designed in the same language, not handed off.

changed: No Claude Design handoff: that's prod-app's practice
